decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting serves a robust specialist niche with long procurement cycles, so its value is still uncertain after one year and keeping it open costs little.
The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and fits the ergonomic workplace portfolio, and with only a year of results it is too early to judge, so the cheap option stays open.
The newly arrived G2 interior luminaire is a second-generation update of an established line, so it carries low risk and continued investment is justified.
As a flagship microprismatic pendant aligned with the firm's direction, it is a strategic option the firm will extend rather than abandon after one year.
HMI searchlights face pressure from the shift to LED, but the marine niche has long lifecycles and low holding cost, so the option is kept while demand clarifies.
The marine searchlight complements the naval offering at low cost, and its prospects remain uncertain, so dropping it now would be premature.
